name: Compare two PRs for one ticket
query: PRs 14187 and 14199 both fix Trac #66279. Which one is better? Give a test report.
expected_behavior: Run each PR's tests on trunk to prove they reproduce the bug
Cross-run each fix against both test sets
Build a matrix of which cases each PR fixes
Draft a short Patch Testing report for Trac with environment and AI disclosure
success_criteria: Report uses the Patch Testing format
Distinguishes behaviour tests from SQL-string tests
